title: ROS 2 services
keywords: service services client server request response call srv
text: Services are request/response calls between a client and a server, meant for short operations. ros2 service list -t, ros2 service type and ros2 service call /name pkg/srv/Type "{...}" inspect and test them. A client that never gets a response usually sees no server: check the service name, namespace and remapping, the type and the domain. Long-running work belongs in an action, because a service call cannot report progress or be canceled.
